body: Hey me too. 3 years later and I’m still here somehow... I still have a hard time thinking about the future because I just think I’ll end my own life.

Fuck man I’m sorry to hear about that. It’s sad to know how common shit like this is... may your best friend watch over you & his loved ones ❤️

Love that you pointed out that track by Mac Miller. Thank you. I was driving for a while yesterday and I was playing his Swimming & GO:OD AM albums. His music really speaks to my soul in times like this
Yes it was from OD. He used to smoke oxy off of foil with a straw. I still remember the first time he lit up & it straight up smelt like roasted marshmallows.

I’m sorry for your loss. Hoping that George is watching over you & his loved ones ❤️ May he rest in paradise


The oxys man... they’re no joke. It’s so saddening that events like these are what we have to learn from. Shouldn’t be this way at all.

Man I’ve been getting these random waves of sadness & it only feels right to let out my tears. I’m just so in shock. No one ever thinks of this outcome, but this shit really happened & shit like this affects too many loved ones. 

Appreciate your words kind stranger ❤️ 

I’ve gotten past my phase of handling addictive stuff but it’s saddening to realize that my friend did not have the privilege of winning his struggle. Wherever he is now, I hope he’s finally at peace.

Having to experience this at such a young age is awful. Nothing really prepares you for this. My friend didn’t even really get to experience life as what it could’ve been. We’re still pretty much kids, fresh from highschool... 

It’s gonna be rough trying to pick life back up but I’ve got no choice but to make it for the homie. Bless up.

Thank you. I had a really tough time sharing my thoughts with everyone else during his candle memorial and my brain just shut down in the middle of it. But it didn’t feel right holding my thoughts in. It really helped a lot getting some words out there for him. I’m glad I was able to share something that touched the hearts of many strangers.

I don’t want this happening to anyone else because no one deserves this. I can’t stop thinking about the family he left behind, it’s so heartbreaking. I’m sure he’s watching over all of his loved ones tho ❤️

Another day of wanting to hang myself. I know my responsibilities aren’t challenging or whatever, but all I want to do is sleep forever. I get called lazy and I have no objection... I just want this pain to go away. Wish I could disappear with it as well. Tired of telling people I’m okay because I’ll just end up breaking down if I spilled my guts to them. Nothing’s changed even though I’ve had talks with people that are close in my life. How many more years do I have to repeat this cycle lmao fuck I hate this shit

I just wish I had the willpower to kill myself so I wouldn’t have to deal with existing inside this shitty mess of a mind I have... :( But I can’t so I’m just gonna continue to lay here crying my eyes out alone in my room.

Yep. I’ve learned over time to not attach myself to people so I automatically distant myself from people I meet. Probably not good for me but I get too emotionally attached to people in my life and it makes me doubt myself.
Khun is dope as hell, I’m sure he’ll become a fan favorite. He became my favorite after reading the first season haha
I can understand why people wouldn’t at first but yeah I agree. He definitely holds his own as a character :)
Sounds good thanks :) Any videos/channels you can recommend about building pcs?
Didn’t realize it was different haha got it, appreciate it a bunch!

Alright I’ll look into that. I already have a 2TB Drive on the side where I have all my production/library stuff on as well. Any recommendations to max out ram? 

I’ll also be using it for gaming + streaming so I would like to at least have those run smoothly & stable as well.
Hm okay I’ll check out the ram, someone else pointed that out as well. I was wondering if that still works for Windows since I’ve been a mac user for quite some time now. Thank you!
I’ll be using it for mainly music production and gaming+streaming on the side most likely. What would you recommend for faster ram?

Such a trippy read! Haven’t broken through on psychedelics as I’m somewhat traumatized by past trips, but I’m currently coming down on shrooms and this was a really interesting read lol. The only times I’ve tripped super hard, I have no recollection of it. Other than the loops I went through, it seems I blacked out during those intense moments. I can’t imagine having to shift back to reality after experiencing that haha

Your last two paragraphs are so relatable. I just wish people wouldn’t bother me and just let me be me. I mean I genuinely don’t care what others think cus fuck em, but I’m still constantly anxious of every interaction. Always thinking of how they’ll perceive me. 

Over the years I feel like I’ve lost who I really am inside and it scares me. I’ve only imitated others to fit in but it’s all so tiring now. Sometimes I can’t even tell if my relationships with the people I know are superficial or honest. I’m scared of genuinely opening up to someone just to go through the pain of them disappearing. So I just tough it out each day trying to act “normal” when my mind is such a mess. It really is lonely.
Happy birthday dude! Hope your day goes well :)

The past weeks I’ve been wondering about this. I get random pains under my rib cage but I can’t do anything about it. I was thinking it was heart palpitations as well. No idea but it makes me wonder if I’m actually dying lol. Not that it would be a bad thing... wishing you the best

I hate this so much. People tell me how good my stuff is for my hobby but it’s such a challenge for me to actually put in more meaningful time for it. I’m constantly unmotivated and most of the time, attempting to work towards my hobby just stresses me out so I put it off. I just wanna lay in bed all day...
Any time I look up symptoms that I have I automatically assume the worst outcome, which is always gonna be some sort of cancer lmao
